title: All catalog item mutation endpoints (create/update/delete) are anonymous
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Mike Kistler; component: Catalog.API/
rationale: Wires builder.AddDefaultAuthentication() into Catalog.API/Extensions (runtime path only, after the IsBuild() guard), adds .RequireAuthorization() to all four mutating routes (PUT v1, PUT v2, POST, DELETE) leaving reads anonymous for the storefront, adds the required Identity:Audience config section, and injects Identity__Url into catalog-api via the AppHost. AMENDMENT NEEDED: the fixture hunk references AutoAuthorizeStartupFilter which the diff does not define in tests/Catalog.FunctionalTests — copy the ~10-line private class from tests/Ordering.FunctionalTests/OrderingApiFixture.cs before the test project compiles.
variants_checked: Only 4 mutation mappings repo-wide in Catalog.API, all fixed; no other AddDefaultAuthentication call site missing; all read routes deliberately left anonymous.
bypass_considered: YARP-relayed mutations now 401 unauthenticated; version hopping finds no unprotected variant; residual anonymous mutations are the event-bus subscribers (separate findings).
test_note: New UpdateCatalogItemWithoutTokenIsRejected (401 without token, 200 anonymous read) in tests/Catalog.FunctionalTests/CatalogApiTests.cs; requires the missing AutoAuthorizeStartupFilter class noted above.
review_reason: Root-cause fix mirroring the fleet pattern exactly (Extensions.cs:10/:12/:5 in sibling services); includes the required Identity section and AppHost env wiring; negative test added. Style 6 only for the test-project compile gap.
